definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.76) EXIT PROGRAM statement is 'an abbreviation for EXIT statement with the PROGRAM phrase', the 2023 3.74 definition less its archaic note; §2002:4 (4.150) procedure 'One or more successive paragraphs or sections in the procedure division' (2023 adds 'paragraph, section'); SR7 restricts the statement to a program procedure division, the same programs, functions and methods in both, so no scope change.
